📺 Outlander: Blood of My Blood (2025–Present)

Outlander: Blood of My Blood explores the extraordinary love stories of Jamie Fraser’s parents, Brian Fraser and Ellen MacKenzie, and Claire Beauchamp’s parents, Henry Beauchamp and Julia Moriston. Set across 18th-century Scotland and World War I-era England, the series follows two couples whose lives become intertwined through romance, family rivalries, dangerous secrets, and unexpected twists of fate. As they struggle against social expectations, political conflicts, and forces threatening to separate them, their relationships shape the family histories behind the original Outlander story. Combining sweeping romance, historical drama, and emotional storytelling, the series explores love, sacrifice, destiny, and the power of family connections.

🎬 Main Cast:

* Jamie Roy as Brian Fraser
* Harriet Slater as Ellen MacKenzie
* Jeremy Irvine as Henry Beauchamp
* Hermione Corfield as Julia Moriston
* Tony Curran as Lord Lovat
* Séamus McLean Ross as Colum MacKenzie
* Sam Retford as Dougal MacKenzie
* Rory Alexander as Murtagh Fitzgibbons Fraser

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Romance • Fantasy • Adventure

⏱️ Runtime: ~60–80 minutes per episode • 2 seasons • TV-MA
